newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sao Paulo firms sack 8,497 workers in January.
newsitem.headline: Sao Paulo firms sack 8,497 workers in January.

text.p: Private firms located in Sao Paulo state laid off 8,497 employees in January, compared to the 8,586 workers fired in December, Sao Paulo State Industries Federation (Fiesp) said in a statement.
Fiesp said January job figures were calculated under a new method which increases the number of sectors in the survey to 47 from 46 and set a new base date at June 1994, previously December 1990.
Fifteen out of the 47 sectors included in the survey hired personnel in the period. Twenty-four sacked people and eight maintained their staff unchanged, it said.
In the last 12 months, Sao Paulo firms have sacked 135,593 workers, or 6.69 percent of Sao Paulo's industrial workforce, it said.
